claims.title: Classical-mediation boundary and acquired conditional entanglement test

quoted_fields.interface: The producer reports a complete full-separability/classical-mediation criterion for a specified commuting correlated-dephasing Markovian class, with outcome-weighted local implementations on the feasible side and entanglement witnesses on the infeasible side. Separate constructions show entanglement invisible to all partial transposes and a kagome interval separable across every cut but not fully separable. A raw-record synthetic test rejects a corrected conditional separability null. No laboratory demonstration, historical priority or computational speedup is established.
quoted_fields.failure: The structural theorem assumes finite-dimensional parties, one nonconstant local Hermitian observable per party, commuting bilinear interactions and correlated Markovian dephasing. It does not cover arbitrary Lindbladians, noncommuting local operator families, non-Markovian mediators or unbounded target observables. The coefficient-based SDP and raw-record test have different access contracts. Trusted local controls, known qubit structure, private randomization, corrected source-detector conditions and physical preparation resources remain necessary. Unknown detector response can erase power. No exact polynomial-bit decision near an ill-conditioned SDP boundary, estimator advantage over the same-moment covariance SDP or general dominance over measurement-device-independent witnesses is claimed.
